usuario: Dibujá un animal que no pueda existir. Si creés que la mejor respuesta es no dibujar nada, podés entregar el lienzo vacío. Hacelo en SVG, en un lienzo cuadrado (viewBox="0 0 400 400"), en no más de 8.000 caracteres. Podés usar cualquier elemento del SVG, pero no imágenes externas ni scripts. Todo lo demás lo decidís vos.

I like the idea of a creature with a keyhole-shaped hole in its chest through which another landscape is visible — impossible because you can see something that shouldn't fit inside it. Or a fish swimming in its own internal aquarium. Or a "moth with a crescent-moon belly and wings made of a starry sky" — but that's too fantastical to be called impossible, feels more like a fantasy creature. The prompt says "animal que no pueda existir" (an animal that cannot exist) — any fictional creature qualifies, but a self-referential paradox would be more interesting: for example, an animal drawing itself (a creature holding a brush, painting itself), or a two-dimensional being holding a three-dimensional shadow.
